descriptorRepairFix.symptom: Controller connect reports the remote helper message although SSH, the helper wrapper and helperPath are correct; the helper returns INFO_FAILED because remote-workspace/run/<instanceKey>.json is missing while the Web process keeps running
descriptorRepairFix.reproducedCause: Companion published the descriptor only at activation and application readiness. A profile live reload or a plugin-manager run disposes that activation and removeDescriptor deletes the file, while the replacement activation never republishes once readiness has already fired. The restricted helper reads only that file, so every later connection attempt failed until an operator restarted the service.
descriptorRepairFix.change: Companion publishes at activation (quiet best effort), again on application readiness, and repairs the descriptor on a five-second loop whenever it is missing, replaced by another boot, bound to another port, incomplete, or when the private directories need tightening. Attempts never overlap, each distinct failure is logged once, the repair timer is unref'ed, and disposal stops the loop before removing only this boot's descriptor. scripts/install-remote-helper.mjs installs the wrapper at the controller's fixed helperPath, or at ~/.local/bin with owner-only mode, and prints the verified helperPath.
